jobs.occupation: Ingénieur-e de recherche en acoustique F/H (H/F)
jobs.description: Pourquoi a-t-on besoin de vous?Le poste est rattaché au chef du groupe Acoustique au sein du département Physique. Vous contribuerez au renouvellement nécessaire des solutions acoustiques de Saint-Gobain pour mieux répondre aux défis du changement climatique.Dans ce cadre, vos missions seront les suivantes:Contribuer à la recherche et à la conception de nouveaux matériaux, produits et systèmes avec des performances acoustiques optimisées, pour les domaines de la construction et de l'industrie des transports.Evaluer les performances acoustiques des solutions in situ dans l'habitat en lien (par l'expérience et la simulation) avec le confort acoustique ressenti.Développer la veille technologique (publications, brevets, normalisation) et la mise en place de partenariats aussi bien avec le milieu industriel qu'avec les laboratoires académiques.***Reporting to the Acoustics Group Leader within the Physics Department, you will contribute to the development and renewal of Saint-Gobain's acoustic solutions to better address the challenges posed by climate change.Your key responsibilities will include:Contribute to the research and design of new materials, products, and systems with optimized acoustic performance for the construction and transport sectors.Evaluate the in-situ acoustic performance of solutions in residential settings, correlating findings (via testing and simulation) with perceived acoustic comfort.Conduct technology monitoring (publications, patents, standardization) and establish partnerships with both industry and academic laboratories.Ce poste est-il fait pour vous ?Nous recherchons avant tout une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, créative et motivée par l'innovation, qui sait présenter ses résultats de manière pédagogique et qui apprécie la résolution de problèmes et le travail collaboratif.Doctorat en acoustique.Poste ouvert à une sortie de thèse ; première expérience après la thèse possible.Expertise en acoustique dans les domaines des matériaux, du génie civil et de l'habitat, avec un vif intérêt pour les travaux expérimentaux et la modélisation numérique (éléments finis).Maîtrise de l'anglais indispensable***We are looking above all for someone who is curious, rigorous, creative and driven by innovation, with the ability to present results in a clear and accessible manner and who enjoys problem-solving and collaborative work.PhD in Acoustics.Position open to recent PhD graduates; previous postdoctoral professional experience is also welcome.Expertise in acoustics applied to materials, civil engineering and building applications, with a strong interest in experimental work and numerical modelling (finite element methods).Fluency in English is essential.

VOTRE MISSION, SI VOUS L'ACCEPTEZEn tant qu'Ingénieur Senior en Équipements de Conditionnement Industriel, vous piloterez le développement et l'amélioration d'équipements industriels afin de soutenir l'innovation des produits, des emballages et des systèmes. Vous apporterez votre expertise technique depuis la phase de concept jusqu'à l'installation et au démarrage en usine, en collaboration avec la R&D, les Opérations, les usines, les achats, les fournisseurs et les autres partenaires. Au quotidien :- Traduire les besoins business en briefs clairs de développement d'équipements, alignés avec les délais et les coûts- Piloter les projets depuis la phase de concept jusqu'aux tests en usine, à l'installation et au démarrage - Développer des solutions innovantes, explorer de nouvelles méthodes et technologies et formaliser les connaissances techniques acquises - Améliorer la performance des équipements dans les usines Purina et proposer des solutions d'ingénierie concrètes et durables - Accompagner l'industrialisation, les démarrages d'usine et les lancements de produits, avec un objectif de performance technique, de zéro déchet et de démarrage vertical efficace - Contribuer aux standards mondiaux relatifs aux équipements et apporter votre expertise à l'organisation Purina au niveau international - Partager les connaissances, former les équipes et accompagner les membres moins expérimentés des équipes projet, tout en contribuant aux réseaux d'experts - Appliquer les exigences de qualité, de sécurité alimentaire, de sécurité des personnes et d'environnement à l'ensemble des activités, et signaler tout écart.   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------As Senior Packaging Equipment Engineer, you will lead the development and improvement of packaging equipment to support product, packaging and system innovation. jobs.description: Job Description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval to In-Service repair solutions . As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event. Your working environment:Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! How we care for you:Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.     Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. Your challenges:We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide.  We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach :  one based in Mobile (USA)  one based in Bangalore (India) The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation.  Your main tasks and responsibilities are: Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).   Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.   Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG).  This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills.  Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company. After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. Your boarding pass:You have an advanced level in English.  You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. You have structure and systems skills.  You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics.  You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus.  You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious. This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.  Not a 100% match? No worries! ensure compliance with ILL and instrument safety regulations, in particular radiation protection regulations.-Become a valued member of the Applied Science group and support your colleagues and users where needed and appropriate.Your profile:- You have a Level 4-6 qualification (e.g. BTEC HNC/HND, undergraduate degree or equivalent) in mechanical engineering, applied physics and instrumentation or equivalent.-You have at least two years of professional experience in the same area.-You have experience in the manufacture, assembly and alignment of precision mechanical, electronic and optical assemblies.-You are proficient in the use of CAD software.-Ideally, you also have some knowledge of computing, electronics and electricity to allow you to take part in other technical projects.-You have a practical approach to your work and are keen to learn new skills.-You are an excellent team player but are also capable of working independently on a wide variety of projects.- You are able to work meticulously and provide support to in-house and visiting scientists.What we offer:Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva).
